groups.t: B8: Cut the Mumbai draw calls
groups.d: Phase 4. Low tier at Mumbai is about 800 to 1000 draw calls and 350 k triangles; get it under 400 calls by merging or instancing landmarks (about 290 meshes) and rails (about 190), and by distance culling. Accepted when ?play&q=low&bench=30 before and after are in PERFORMANCE.md.

groups.t: B9: Real-phone benchmark and checks
groups.d: Phase 4. Run ?play&q=low&bench=30 and ?play&city=delhi&q=low&bench=30 on a real phone and a Mac, and tick the four phone lines in CHECKLIST.md (sound after first tap, Horn, home-screen icon, layout). Needs a person with the devices. Accepted when the numbers (commit, device, tier, visible window, p95, p99) are in PERFORMANCE.md.

groups.t: B10: Move the Delhi router off the main thread (R09)
groups.d: A route across the city takes 80 to 140 ms (node tools/measure_city.mjs). Use a worker or cooperative slices. Accepted when no frame is blocked more than about 8 ms by routing and the route result is the same.

groups.d: Shadows: trees, the car and rocks cast clean shadows: no black streaks, stripes or flicker on trees or the car (check the Alps at midday).

groups.t: Ground
groups.d: Ground: photographic grass, rock on cliffs, snow, sand. No seams at tile edges, no shimmering as you drive. Compare with &ground=flat.

groups.t: Scenery
groups.d: Scenery: real trees, shrubs and rocks, no dark fringes or flicker. Compare with &nature=flat.

groups.t: Bridge
groups.d: Bridge: drive onto one (Alps, seed alps, near road distance 340; it is 726 m long and has a steel truss on both sides: top chord, uprights and diagonals, lined up from piece to piece with no gaps; short bridges have rails only): deck, rails, piers; the car rides the deck. Rails stop the car: steer into one at speed, the car scrapes or stops and never goes over the edge (try the car, truck and bike). Rails sit just w…

groups.t: Tunnel
groups.d: Tunnel (Himalayas, seed hill): gate with a readable "ATAL TUNNEL, ROHTANG" board, portal, tiled lit interior, cones, a raised walkway along both walls, speed-limit (60), green EXIT and orange SOS signs on the walls, camera stays inside, no rain inside. Try the truck.

groups.t: Weather and time
groups.d: Weather and time: clear, overcast, fog, rain, storm, snow, each at day, dusk and night: nothing goes black or white, road looks wet in rain, tunnel and bridge look right at night.

groups.t: Driving controls
groups.d: Driving controls: W / Up gas, S / Down reverse (brakes first if still rolling forward, then reverses), Space foot brake (stops and holds the car, never reverses), X handbrake (the tail slides), Shift boost, E autodrive. On a phone: Brake, Hand, Rev and Boost circles. Lifting off the gas slows the car at a natural rate, on grass much faster than on the road (it must not glide). Measured: 100 km/h to a stop in about 3…

groups.t: Engine sound
groups.d: Engine sound is the real recording of Rajul's car (seven seamless loops in assets/audio, made by tools/make_engine_loops.mjs): deep and bold, no thin whine, smooth through the gears, no swirling or clicking at loop points, no sudden jumps when the revs change. ?engine=synth plays the old synthesised engine for comparison. Nobody has listened to it yet: judge by ear and say what is off. If it still sounds unnatural t…

groups.t: Camera views
groups.d: Camera views: V cycles Chase, Far chase, Close chase, Hood, Bumper, Driver seat, Cinematic (a TV-style cut beside the road) and back; C jumps to the driver's seat and back; the Camera button and the CAM circle on a phone do the same as V. Each view shows the road ahead, nothing clips through the car body, and the choice is remembered.

groups.t: Car feel
groups.d: Car feel (drive by hand, any vehicle): the nose rises a little when you accelerate and dips when you brake hard; the body leans outward in a fast corner; a faint tremble at speed, stronger on gravel and grass. It should not feel like gliding on rails. (Measured on the car: about 3 degrees squat on launch, about 4 degrees dip under hard braking, about 4.5 degrees of lean at 0.5 g sideways.)

groups.t: The car
groups.d: The car ("Dusk GT", Khronos CarConcept): glossy paint with reflections, dark glass, lit tail lights, plain licence plate; no Khronos or 3D Commerce logo anywhere (look at the tyre sidewalls and the plate up close); the four wheels turn and the front ones steer; the garage colour swatches recolour the body; driver's-seat view (V or C) shows a full interior with the steering wheel and dash.

groups.t: Handling
groups.d: Handling (car): steering reacts at once (not numb) at 50, 100 and 200 km/h; no spin at full lock at top speed; a handbrake flick at 100 km/h gives a slide you can hold and catch; gears change with a small power dip and the revs drop at each shift; the rev limiter holds at the top.

groups.t: Look
groups.d: Look: richer colour and a soft dark edge (grade and vignette); trees are full and green with no black rectangles in sunlight; the car's paint shows a horizon and sky in its reflection.

groups.t: Camera effects
groups.d: Camera effects: the view stretches a little when you boost or launch hard; no camera shake by default.

groups.t: Autodrive
groups.d: Autodrive (press E, or the Auto button): the car follows the road by itself at about 70 km/h, slows for bends, goes through tunnels and over bridges; steering or braking by hand takes over. Try the Himalayas (seed hill) and the default world. With traffic on, it drives in its own lane (right, or left in India), follows a slower car at a gap, and never hits a car.

groups.t: Green Valley
groups.d: Green Valley looks like open meadow with tall grass and trees set back from the road, not a forest at the verge.

groups.t: Quality tiers
groups.d: Quality tiers: add &q=low, &q=med, &q=high. Low: old cheap ground, fewer tree variants, no shadows; med: lighter photographic ground; high: full ground, bigger shadows and view. Each looks acceptable and none shows broken ground. Phones start on low. (Draw calls and triangles for the Alps at 1400x800: low 176 / 96k, med 523 / 430k, high 898 / 895k. High took about 24 ms on an M4: too slow, still to be tuned.)

groups.t: Vehicles
groups.d: Vehicles: the garage lists Dusk GT (your original sports car with the striped paint), Freight Hauler, Volt Bike and Aero Concept (the new detailed coupe); all four drive; paint colours work; white paint does not glare to a white blob.

groups.t: Radio and sound
groups.d: Radio and sound: radio wheel (hold Q) plays a station; engine, wind and rain sounds; no rain, snow or thunder sound or picture inside a tunnel (try the Himalayas, seed hill, rain).

groups.t: Traffic
groups.d: Traffic (Settings > Traffic: Off, Low, Mid, High; Off on phones, Low on medium, Mid on high by default): the cars are real vehicle shapes (sedans, SUVs, vans, taxis, police, ambulance, trucks, garbage and fire trucks) in many colours, not boxes; they drive in their own lanes on the right (on the left in Mumbai, Delhi and Agra), oncoming cars pass on the other side; none appear close to you; a car behind or ahead kee…

groups.t: My music
groups.d: My music: in the radio wheel press "Add my songs" and pick a few audio files (also try a text file and a very large file: they are left out with a message). A "My music" tab appears, the songs play one after another and loop, "Next song" skips, "Radio off" stops. After a reload the songs are gone (they are never uploaded or stored); check that nothing was sent over the network (browser network panel).

groups.t: Controller rumble
groups.d: Controller rumble (a gamepad that can vibrate): a thump on hitting something, a light buzz on gravel or grass, a rumble in a slide, a push on boost; Settings > Controller rumble > Off stops it. Playing with no gamepad works exactly as before.

groups.d: Saved choices: in the browser console localStorage.setItem('gfp-next', '{"paint":null,"radioVol":"loud","vehicle":"x"}') then reload: the game starts normally with defaults and no red errors.

groups.t: Drive modes (N)
groups.d: Drive modes (N): cycle Eco, Normal, Sport, Off-road for the car, the truck and the bike. Eco: softer throttle, stops pulling at about 110 km/h. Sport: sharper throttle, quicker steering. Off-road: stops at about 85 km/h, grips better on grass and gravel, and holds a slow speed on a steep downhill with your feet off the pedals. The tag beside the speed shows the mode. Judge by feel on a phone and with a gamepad.
